selected_object_pool.init_loop: head + 0xc through head + 0xb0c exclusive, step 0x58; clears object +8 and appends each object while incrementing head +8.
selected_object_pool.take: head equal to sentinel returns null; otherwise unlink first object, decrement free count, call 0x1b554 callback with the descriptor index, store pointer at object +8 and index at +0xc.
selected_object_pool.return: selected pointer range chooses this list, clears object +8, appends object and increments head +8; conditional frame-index release through 0xf000b9ec is not traced.
